engine.plan_failed: The plan failed and everything it created was rolled back: {error}
engine.plan_failed_rollback_incomplete: The plan failed and {count} resource(s) could not be rolled back: {error}
engine.secret_in_plan: Node '{node}': field '{field}' must be a secret reference (secret:<name>), never a secret value.
engine.plan_rejected: PLAN REJECTED: {count} resource(s) cannot be provisioned as requested. No changes were made.

contract.provider_name_missing: A provider declaration must name its provider.
contract.kind_undeclared: Provider '{provider}' does not declare a capability for {kind}; every kind must be declared as NATIVE, CONDITIONAL or UNSUPPORTED.
contract.adapter_for_unsupported: Provider '{provider}' declares {kind} as UNSUPPORTED but supplies an adapter for it.
contract.adapter_missing: Provider '{provider}' declares {kind} as supported but supplies no adapter for it.
contract.conditional_without_modes: Provider '{provider}' declares {kind} as CONDITIONAL without naming the modes it supports.
contract.provider_not_registered: Provider '{provider}' is not registered; install and configure it before using it in a plan.

reason.kubernetes_network: Kubernetes has no network boundary of its own; networking is supplied by the cluster. A bare CIDR block cannot be applied, only NetworkPolicy traffic rules are supported.
reason.kubernetes_database: Core Kubernetes has no managed database primitive; a database container is not equivalent to a managed database.
reason.kubernetes_storage: Kubernetes serves FILE and BLOCK storage through persistent volume claims; it has no object storage.
reason.linux_network: A Linux host is configured only through a declared network backend (existing, NetworkManager, systemd-networkd or Netplan); Ugondu never reconfigures host networking unasked.
reason.linux_database: A plain Linux host has no managed database primitive; Ugondu does not install database servers on a host unasked.
reason.cpanel_compute: cPanel hosts applications inside an account; it cannot provide general compute resources.
reason.cpanel_network: A cPanel account has no network boundary that Ugondu can manage.
reason.cpanel_storage: cPanel provides account file storage only; it has no object storage.

alt.install_plugin: Install and activate a database operator plugin that declares this capability.
alt.target_managed_provider: Target a provider that offers a managed database service.
alt.remove_resource: Remove this resource from the plan.
alt.target_network_provider: Target a provider that offers a network boundary.
alt.use_network_policy_mode: Set the node's provider mode to NETWORK_POLICY.
alt.use_file_or_block_class: Use the FILE or BLOCK storage class.
alt.target_object_storage_provider: Target a provider that offers object storage.
alt.declare_network_backend: Declare the network backend in the node's provider mode.
alt.use_hosted_app_mode: Set the node's provider mode to HOSTED_APP.
alt.use_mysql_mode: Use the MySQL engine with the MYSQL provider mode.
alt.target_compute_provider: Target a provider that offers compute capacity.
alt.set_provider_mode: Set providerOptions.mode to one of the supported modes.
alt.use_supported_storage_class: Use one of the storage classes this provider supports.
alt.use_supported_engine: Use one of the database engines this provider supports.
alt.allow_public_storage_policy: Ask a policy administrator to allow public storage.
alt.confirm_public_access: Set publicAccessConfirmed to true once you have reviewed the security implications.

rejection.mode_required: Provider '{provider}' supports {kind} only in a declared mode; set providerOptions.mode to one of: {modes}.
rejection.mode_unsupported: Mode '{mode}' is not supported by provider '{provider}' for {kind}; supported: {modes}.
rejection.storage_class_unsupported: Provider '{provider}' does not support the {storageClass} storage class; supported: {classes}.
rejection.database_engine_unsupported: Provider '{provider}' does not support the {engine} database engine; supported: {engines}.
rejection.public_storage_unsupported: Public access is not meaningful for {storageClass} storage on provider '{provider}'.
rejection.public_storage_prohibited: Storage '{node}' requests public access, which the current policy prohibits.
rejection.public_storage_unconfirmed: PUBLIC STORAGE WARNING: storage '{node}' permits anonymous read access. Confirm that you understand the security implications.
